title: Sidebar surface replacement and same-crate review cohort
interpretation: This is a 150-body review/replacement cohort, not a 150-test deletion claim. The 141 keep rows reuse substantive body reviews from the frozen source audit and remain unchanged. The nine SidebarLayout bodies are mapped to the new public-render surface test, which has been added but not built or executed. Net source-body reduction is nine old bodies replaced by one new body, or eight fewer bodies.
